mentions.name: Onvibe
mentions.description: This platform creates websites through the chat interface of an LLM, working like a PaaS oriented to LLMs. Any UI that supports MCP should work. It includes Postgres, file uploads, and email, and its MCP server provides tools to run migrations, snapshots, and drafts.
mentions.audience: Anyone using an LLM chat interface to build their own custom tools; started so the author's wife and daughter could create their own tools.
mentions.source_excerpt: A project where you create websites by just using the chat interface of your llm. It's like a paas but oriented to llms. If your ui support mcp It should work.
